name: nerve
description: Nerve — agent status plugins that push Claude Code, Codex, and Grok sessions into a local status hub, shown in the macOS menu bar, the Windows tray, tmux, or VS Code.

plugins.name: nerve
plugins.description: Report agent session lifecycle to the Nerve status hub (http://127.0.0.1:17890). Works with Claude Code and Codex (and Grok via Claude-compatible hooks).
